notes:
Summary: Ventana runs personalization + dynamic search for multiple retail partners. Peak bursts 5-8x baseline during flash sales (Black Friday peaks expected). Primary ask: predictable p99 latency < 75ms for reranker and < 200ms for embedding-based search under burst. They expect sustained throughput spikes up to ~12k QPS at storefront layer; backend rerank jobs vary.

Recent sentiment: technical fit uncertain because of queueing risk and capacity headroom — engineering skeptical about shared hosted tiers. Procurement is price-sensitive; finance flagged ARR threshold. SE flagged that Dedicated can meet p99 with right cluster sizing but needs commitment window.

"Quotes/Call snippets":
- "We can't have a queue build up during sale windows — a backlog kills conversions." — Head of Infra (11/05)
- "If latency spikes, we pause feature rollouts — it's non-negotiable." — PM (10/01)

Decision drivers: latency SLOs, deterministic capacity, multi-region failover, KMS integration. They prefer vendor who can demo realistic burst behavior and show autoscaling/fallback without tail latency spikes.

Why stalled/closed-lost risk:
- Internal champion (product lead) moved teams; outreach to replacement stalled.
- Budget hold instituted Nov by CFO pending vendor consolidation review.
- Shortlist narrowed to Xcelerate.AI (cheaper committed offering) and CloudRanker (on-prem option).

Recommendation from AE/SE: propose a 4-week Dedicated POC with measured burst test harness (our infra runs simulated 12k QPS), include clear failure-mode playbook and cost-profile for steady vs burst. Provide SSO/KMS compliance answers and an ops runbook.

Notes on POC: preliminary sizing estimate attached in Drive doc. SE requested capacity telemetry from Ventana (current p95/p99, QPS histogram) — still outstanding.

Internal next moves: pricing review with commercial ops, schedule 30m call with Head of Infra week of 2025-11-24, re-share dedicated POC T&Cs.
